'''Annance''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Empire Forever]]''. He accompanied [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] on an inspection tour during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Captain Annance awaited the arrival of [[Coh Veshiv]]. Throughout his command, he ordered all personnel under his command to remain out of combat against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as he was given the exact assignment to ferry Advisor Veshiv.<ref name="Orbit" />

During the course to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] onboard the ''Empire Forever'', Annance grew steadily more annoyed by Veshiv's complaining about his wanting to accompany a cruiser rather than the modest corvette through his inspection.<ref name="Orbit" />
